TextView.android:text: Arangkada Terms & Conditions
Welcome to Arangkada — your trusted UV Express carpooling app. By using this application, you agree to the following Terms and Conditions:
1. Definition of Terms

“App” or “Arangkada” – refers to the Arangkada mobile application operated by Arangkada team.

“User” – refers to any individual who registers, creates a profile, and books rides through the app.

“Admin” – refers to authorized drivers or operators who manage bookings and ride schedules through a separate admin account (e.g., ending in @admin.com).

“Service” – refers to the carpooling and ride-booking features provided by the app.

“Booking” – refers to a confirmed ride request made through the app.

“Payment” – refers to the exchange of fare made in cash or via GCash.
2. Eligibility

• Users must be at least 18 years old to create an account and use the app.\n• Users agree to provide accurate, current, and complete information when registering.\n• The app reserves the right to suspend or terminate accounts found to contain false or misleading information.
3. User Accounts

• Each user must create an account to access booking features.
• Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their login credentials.
• The app is not responsible for any unauthorized use of an account.
• Admin accounts are exclusively for verified drivers and operators; regular users are not allowed to access admin credentials.
4. Booking and Ride Policies

• Users can book rides between Cervantes and Baguio City only.
• Ride schedules, seat availability, and fares are managed by the admin.
• Users must arrive on time at the agreed pickup point.
• Cancellations should be made at least 30 minutes before departure.
• No-shows may lead to temporary suspension of booking privileges.
• Arangkada acts as a booking facilitator and does not directly operate transportation vehicles.
5. Payments

• Payments can be made through cash or GCash.
• Users are responsible for entering correct payment details.
• No refunds will be issued once a ride has commenced.
• Arangkada is not responsible for payment errors or transfers made outside the app’s official channels.
6. User Conduct

Users agree to:
• Treat all drivers, admins, and other passengers with respect and courtesy.
• Avoid any illegal, offensive, or harmful behavior during rides.
• Refrain from creating fake bookings, duplicate accounts, or misusing the app.
Violation of these rules may result in suspension or permanent termination of account access.
7. Privacy and Data Protection

• Arangkada collects user data such as name, contact number, and booking history for service improvement.
• All personal data is stored securely and used only for operational purposes.
• User data will not be sold or shared with third parties without consent, except as required by law.
• Users may request deletion of their account and personal data by contacting support.
8. Limitation of Liability

• Arangkada serves only as a platform connecting passengers to transport services.
• The app is not liable for accidents, delays, or incidents during rides.
• The app is not responsible for lost or damaged personal belongings.
• Users assume all responsibility for their safety and belongings during rides.
9. Suspension or Termination

The app reserves the right to suspend or terminate user accounts that:
• Violate these Terms.
• Engage in fraudulent or abusive behavior.
• Interfere with app operations or other users’ experiences.
Users may voluntarily delete or deactivate their account at any time.
10. Updates to the Terms

• Arangkada may update or modify these Terms and Conditions from time to time.\n• Any changes will be posted within the app.\n• Continued use of the app after such updates constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.
11. Contact Information
For questions, concerns, or feedback regarding these Terms, please contact us at:\n📧 arangkada.support@gmail.com\n📍 Baguio City, Benguet, Philippines
12. Governing Law
These Terms and Conditions shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Republic of the Philippines. Any disputes shall be resolved in the proper courts of Benguet Province.
